Overview

Tokushima is a city in Tokushima with a population of 260,000. Famous for the Awa Odori dance festival, one of Japan’s largest, and the dramatic Naruto whirlpools. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
